name: Humble Spell
text: For basic spells, basic movements; you can do without flamboyant gestures or showy signs of power. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell, it loses the manipulate trait and gains the subtle trait. The trait hides only the spell's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects, so an observer might still see a ray streak out from you or see you vanish into thin air.
